title: Recap: Cooking Verbs That Happen by Themselves

sections.title: Describing Cooking Processes Without Specifying the Agent
sections.content: You know from A2 Units 22 and 31 that a prefix such as *meg-* can mark a finished action, and that some verbs say that something happens by itself. In cooking, compare *fő* (is cooking) and *megfő* (gets done), *sül* (is baking) and *megsül* (gets done); a person *főz* or *süt* it. Also *megpuhul* (becomes soft) and *elkészül* (gets ready).

items.spanish: A leves két óra alatt megfő.
items.english: The soup is cooked in two hours.

items.spanish: A hús egy óra alatt megpuhul.
items.english: The meat becomes soft in an hour.
